newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Lufthansa to fly to Kazan, Perm in Russia.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa to fly to Kazan, Perm in Russia.

text.p: Deutsche Lufthansa AG will begin regular flights between Frankfurt and Perm, in Russia's Ural mountain region, via Kazan, the capital of Tatarstan, the company's Moscow office said on Friday.
"From March 31 Lufthansa will start regular flights to both Russian cities...operating an A-319 jet," the company statement said, referring to an Airbus Industrie airplane.
Flights are scheduled for Mondays and Thursdays.
Lufthansa operates regular flights from Germany to six Russian destinations and to seven other former Soviet republic capitals, it said. -- Viktor Anoshkin, Moscow Newsroom, +7095 941 8520
